rulesHint: Generated by the rule engine (fallback when AI is unavailable)
degradedHint: Some dependencies were unavailable; generated from degraded data

list.title: Recommendations
list.description: Review AI and rule-based recommendations, approve to execute actions and track outcomes.

emptyHint.Proposed: New recommendations appear here when alerts fire or when you click "Generate AI recommendation" in a scenario.
emptyHint.other: Switch to another status to see more.

detail.generating: AI is analyzing the evidence and drafting a recommendation…
detail.generatingHint: This usually takes a few seconds. The page refreshes every 3 s and shows the summary, actions and evidence when ready.
detail.failedHint: Neither AI nor the rule fallback could produce a recommendation. Retry later or run the scenario again.
detail.localeHint: The summary and rationale were generated in {locale}; switching language does not change AI content. Numbers and evidence stay the same.

actions.title: Recommended actions
actions.subtitle: Ranked by expected impact; impacts come from the simulator

approve.title: Confirm approve & execute
approve.description: {count, plural, one {# action} other {# actions}} will be executed immediately and recorded in the audit log.
approve.auditHint: Results and the operator are written to the action log, visible on each object.

reject.title: Reject recommendation
reject.description: Tell us why, so future recommendations improve.
reject.tooLong: The reason must be at most 500 characters
reject.placeholder: e.g. The alternative supplier is not certified yet

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.subtitle: Click an item to open the property and its lineage
evidence.itemAria: Evidence {n}: {property} of {object} is {value}; open property lineage

simulation.title: Simulation summary
simulation.subtitle: Numbers come from the simulator, not the LLM

feedback.title: Outcome feedback
feedback.thanks: Thanks — your feedback improves future recommendations.
feedback.ratingRequired: Choose a rating from 1 to 5 stars
feedback.commentTooLong: The comment must be at most 1000 characters
